pages.title: A Changed Face
pages.text: Be watched long enough by the Hunger and the sun and moon themselves stop looking quite so ordinary - a knowing, watching face settles into them. It's a one-way change; once it's happened, it doesn't undo itself, no matter what Faith does afterward.

pages.title: Looking Away
pages.text: The Sun and Moon Ward can't stop it from happening, but right-click to hold it and the sky settles back into its familiar shape - purely cosmetic, fully reversible, and undone again with another right-click whenever you'd rather see the truth of it.
